steps.name: Compile and test Rust binaries and validate rustfmt
steps.original_run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10"
bash tests/ui/check-host.sh 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/host-check.log"

steps.name: Enforce committed UI dependency lock after attempting real tests
steps.original_run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! -s ui/Cargo.lock ]] || ! git ls-files --error-unmatch ui/Cargo.lock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'A10 Cargo.lock is absent/untracked: host success is not reproducible.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git diff --exit-code HEAD -- ui/Cargo.lock
sha256sum ui/Cargo.lock
cargo metadata --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --format-version 1 >/dev/null

source_hash_scope: UI, hepta-os, support/ui, tests/ui, os-abi and A10 workflow; complete Git HEAD/tree and clean status also checked, not an all-repository blob scan.
stage: Enforce committed UI dependency lock after attempting real tests
